name: claudia.gallery
about: Claudia, the open character from the music videos ESCAPE VELOCITY, CLODYSSEY, BLISS, AIRPLANE MODE, DOWNFORCE, DON'T LET ME SCROLL, WHITEPILL and THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE: every Midjourney image and prompt, the films, and how to make her yourself, for people and agents.
credit: Directed by anabology; made with Claude, Midjourney, Seedance, Wan and Suno. Fan work about Claude; not affiliated with Anthropic.
use: Claudia is an open character: anyone may make work with her. A credit ('Claudia by anabology') is appreciated, not required. See /use/.

item_fields.film: escape-velocity | clodyssey | bliss | airplane-mode | downforce | dont-let-me-scroll | whitepill | the-cake-is-not-a-lie
item_fields.prompt: the Midjourney prompt as it ran
item_fields.params: parameters as they ran, without the director's personal profile
item_fields.profile: true if it ran with the director's personal profile
item_fields.plate: true if this image is a plate in the finished film (EV: recovered by matching the cut; AIRPLANE MODE: its final cut; DOWNFORCE: a first frame or reference of a video take in the final cut, directly or through a frame of an earlier take; DON'T LET ME SCROLL: a first frame or reference of a take in the final cut, directly or through an outfit swap, or her avatar on the posts; its feed pictures are not marked; WHITEPILL: her dress and the places of her shots, which reach the final cut as references for the previz and the Seedance takes, since no Midjourney image is on screen as it is; THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE: the image a first frame of a take in the final cut was made from, through GPT Image 2.5's fix of the faces)
item_fields.cut: picked but its shot was cut (AIRPLANE MODE, DOWNFORCE and DON'T LET ME SCROLL: not in the final cut; WHITEPILL: a place of the previz that is not in the final cut; THE CAKE IS NOT A LIE: picked for the library, a test or storyboard v5, and not behind a take in the final cut)
item_fields.edited: the plate was corrected with an image-edit model
item_fields.verdict: the director's verdict (CLODYSSEY's storyboard review; AIRPLANE MODE's notes on its first cut, on the shot built from the image): pick | reject | comment
item_fields.framing: ECU, CU, MCU, MS, MWS, full, WS, EWS, aerial, macro, sheet
item_fields.url: s, m and full image files
